RICE+LIPKA ARCHITECTS seeks CA Architect/Designer
RL is an award-winning studio with a focus on cultural, education, and public works with an enduring sense of place. We strive to bring a civic-minded intelligence and resourceful vigor to a diverse range of building, planning, and research projects.
We seek an experienced, detail oriented, highly organized architect/designer for immediate construction administration work on a public library now under construction. Possible role expansion to other phases of work including technical development on range of cultural projects. This is a full-time, on-premises position (with associated site presence).
REQUIREMENTS
Applications are only accepted by email, as a single pdf file. Include work samples, cv, salary expectation (may be a range), references, and availability. All components of the application must be combined into a single PDF document no larger than 8mb. Please include "CA app" in email subject line.
No response will be issued to applications submitted in other formats, including links to personal websites or portfolios, or from professional recruiters.
Submit .pdf applications, by email only, to [email protected].
